data.label: Staff user (browser)
data.description: Person using the assistant in a browser. Client reference only, not provisioned.

data.label: Web app
data.description: Authenticated chat UI. Signs users in with Entra ID (auth code + PKCE) and shows answers with their source citations.

data.label: Identity
data.description: App registration issuing tokens with user and group claims. Whether we use an existing tenant or a new test tenant is still open.

data.label: RAG API
data.description: Validates the JWT, maps the user to groups, filters chunks by ACL, runs bounded keyword retrieval, calls the model and returns a cited answer, or declines if nothing permitted matches. Fails closed for unknown identities.

data.label: Document catalog + ACLs
data.description: Stores chunks, keywords, document revisions and explicit source ACLs. Read by the API; written only by ingestion.

data.label: Synthetic documents
data.description: Private container holding the synthetic UTF-8 documents and their permission metadata.

data.label: Ingestion
data.description: Chunks new or updated documents, extracts keywords and writes chunks with their ACLs to the catalog, using managed identity.

data.label: LLM
data.description: Chat model deployment that generates grounded answers. The model, regional availability and quota are not yet verified. Local tests use scripted responses instead.

data.label: Monitoring & audit
data.description: Logs requests, access denials and latency without storing document text.

brief.application: Use Azure for this synthetic architecture qualification. Answer questions over a small synthetic document collection with citations. Include ingestion, retrieval, model runtime, identity enforcement and an authenticated application. Use bounded keyword retrieval for this first test and keep all source permissions. Draw the complete end-to-end architecture with concrete service choices and connected flows. Explain the first local test, distinguish mocked model behavior from actual model validation, and ask one useful missing-decision question. Do not reduce this application to storage to satisfy generator coverage. Do not invent successful deployment or approved region/account access.

decisions.subject: design.azure-bounded-keyword-rag-first-end-to-end-sketch
decisions.title: Azure bounded-keyword RAG – first end-to-end sketch
decisions.context: Scope: an authenticated web app, sign-in with Entra ID, an API that enforces permissions and runs keyword retrieval, a catalog that stores document chunks and their ACLs, ingestion from Blob Storage, Azure OpenAI for generating answers, and monitoring. Assumptions: this is a small synthetic collection, the region is still to be chosen, and model access, quotas and region availability have not been verified. None of these Azure components has a native generator implementation here, so they are design intent that still needs engineering. Nothing is deployed.
decisions.decision: Drawn while talking as design revision 2.

needs.statement: Proposed: answers use only chunks the signed-in user may read under the source ACLs, and unknown identities are denied.
needs.rationale: If permissions are not enforced, an answer could leak a restricted document.
needs.basis: User: "keep all source permissions" and "identity enforcement".

needs.statement: Proposed: every answer cites the source documents it used, and the assistant declines to answer when no permitted source matches.
needs.rationale: Citations let users check answers. Declining when there is no source reduces made-up answers.
needs.basis: User: "Answer questions over a small synthetic document collection with citations".

needs.statement: Proposed: deploy all data and model processing in an Azure region inside the required country (country still to be confirmed).
needs.rationale: Region choice limits which models are available and decides where the data is stored.
needs.basis: Inferred proposal; the user has not stated a country.
